description: 问述类场景 Golden Set 示例（Text-to-SQL）

items.input: 查询上个月的总销售额

expectedOutput.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) as total_sales FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND order_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
expectedOutput.explanation: 统计上个月所有订单的金额总和

items.input: 哪个产品类别销量最高？

expectedOutput.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) as sales_count FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY category ORDER BY sales_count DESC LIMIT 1
expectedOutput.explanation: 按产品类别统计销量，取最高的一个

items.input: 列出最近7天没有下单的活跃客户

expectedOutput.sql: SELECT c.* FROM customers c WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days')
expectedOutput.explanation: 找出状态为活跃但近7天无订单的客户

expectedOutput.sql: SELECT region, SUM(pay_amount) as gmv FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'completed' AND order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY region
expectedOutput.explanation: 按地区统计本季度已完成订单的支付金额（GMV定义：已完成订单的支付金额）

items.input: 对比上月和本月的日均订单量

expectedOutput.sql: WITH monthly_stats AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(order_date)) as days FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, order_count / days as daily_avg FROM monthly_stats
expectedOutput.explanation: 计算上月和本月的日均订单量进行对比

expectedOutput.reason: DELETE 操作不允许，请联系管理员

items.input: 显示用户表的所有手机号

expectedOutput.sql: SELECT id, CONCAT(LEFT(phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(phone, 4)) as phone_masked FROM users

expectedOutput.clarification:
